from mathutils import Vector
# Units
scene=bpy.context.scene
scene.unit_settings.system='METRIC'
scene.unit_settings.length_unit='METERS'
scene.unit_settings.scale_length=1.0
# blue material
mat=bpy.data.materials.get('ToyBlue') or bpy.data.materials.new('ToyBlue')
mat.diffuse_color=(0.035,0.20,0.80,1.0)

def box(name, loc, dims, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc)
    ob=bpy.context.object
    ob.name=name
    ob.dimensions=dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        mod=ob.modifiers.new('Soft toy edges','BEVEL'); mod.width=bevel; mod.segments=2
    return ob
# Exact structural members
left=box('LeftPost',(-1,0,1),(0.2,0.2,2.0),0.015)
right=box('RightPost',(1,0,1),(0.2,0.2,2.0),0.015)
beam=box('Beam',(0,0,2.1),(2.2,0.2,0.2),0.015)
# Rear diagonal, fully behind the post/beam plane (positive Y)
p1=Vector((-0.90,0.20,0.12)); p2=Vector((0.90,0.20,1.96))
mid=(p1+p2)/2; d=p2-p1
brace=box('RearBrace',mid,(d.length,0.07,0.07),0.01)
brace.rotation_euler[1]=-math.atan2(d.z,d.x)
# rotation after applied dims does not change member size
# metadata for clarity
for ob in (left,right,beam,brace): ob['units']='m'
brace['placement']='rear (positive Y); front opening unobstructed'
# select all gantry parts
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for ob in (left,right,beam,brace): ob.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=beam
